description: ECHO: Retrieve one civil enforcement case by case number, with the facilities, defendants, and settlements behind it. Returns the case's category, enforcement type, status, lead agency, relief sought, outcome, court and DOJ docket numbers, summary, and penalty, cost-recovery, compliance-action, and SEP totals; the laws and sections cited; the facilities the case names, one per EPA Registry ID, with address, NAICS and SIC codes, and the program IDs the case links (pass a registryId to epa_echo_get_facility for its compliance profile); defendants; pollutants; milestones; and the enforcement conclusions (orders, consent decrees, or other settlements), each with its facilities, dates, penalties and costs, complying actions, pollutant reductions, and Supplemental Environmental Projects. Facilities and enforcement conclusions come a page at a time and everything else whole on every page; each call re-reads the whole case report, so one call with a larger limit costs less than several pages. Take the case number from epa_echo_search_violations or from a formal action's caseId in epa_echo_get_facility. Civil cases only: a criminal CR_ case number fails before any request.

case_id.description: Civil enforcement case number: a caseId from epa_echo_search_violations (e.g. "03-2014-7010", "WA-100446") or a formal action's caseId from epa_echo_get_facility (e.g. "WAPSCAF000000000000000416"). Criminal case numbers ("CR_1270") are rejected.

enforcement_conclusions_limit.description: Number of enforcement conclusions to return in one call. Default 10; a larger value returns the rest of the list. Page past it with enforcement_conclusions_offset and enforcementConclusionsNextOffset.

enforcement_conclusions_offset.description: Number of enforcement conclusions to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's enforcementConclusionsNextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

facilities_limit.description: Number of facilities to return in one call. Default 25; a larger value returns the rest of the list. Page past it with facilities_offset and facilitiesNextOffset.

facilities_offset.description: Number of facilities to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's facilitiesNextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

name: epa_echo_get_case

complianceActionCostInDollars.description: Estimated cost of injunctive relief to return to compliance, in dollars

costRecoveryInDollars.description: Response costs agreed or ordered repaid (CERCLA), in dollars

defendants.description: Empty when ECHO records none, as on many state cases

namedInComplaint.description: True when the complaint names them

namedInSettlement.description: True when a settlement names them

items.description: One settlement or order concluding part of the case

complyingActions.description: Actions required to return to compliance

enforcementConclusionsNextOffset.description: Next enforcement_conclusions_offset; absent on the last page

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `criminal_case`: case_id is a criminal (CR_) case number. `case_not_found`: ECHO has no civil case report for case_id. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facilities.description: One per Registry ID, possibly in several states

noLongerExists.description: True when FRS marks it no longer existing

registryId.description: Pass as registry_id to epa_echo_get_facility; absent when ECHO records none

facilitiesNextOffset.description: Next facilities_offset; absent on the last page

stateLocalPenaltyInDollars.description: State or local, whole case, in dollars

truncated.description: True when facilities or enforcementConclusions has more pages; absent otherwise.

title: Get EPA Enforcement Case
